mike_customer: Hey @support — urgent audit request. Need evidence of deletion for user data under EU tenant `eu-42` (DPA/ID: 0xACB). Also need KMS/HSM key provenance for keys used to encrypt that tenant, and an export of retained logs. We saw a 403 when calling DELETE /v1/records with our service token. Can you confirm what you can provide and give repro steps for the delete API?

julia_support: Thanks — we can help. First: can you share the account/org id and a sample request (headers + request id if available)? 403 usually means the token doesn't have the `records:delete` scope or the principal is missing the owner claim. Quick repro for your team:

curl -X DELETE https://api.redwood.ai/v1/records \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <SERVICE_TOKEN>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"owner":"eu-42","record_ids":["abc123"]}'

If token lacks scope you'll get 403 with body like `{\"error\":\"forbidden\",\"reason\":\"missing_scope:records:delete\"}`. If you paste the exact error body we can confirm. For DPA evidence (deletion certificate + audit export) we need owner confirmation and a request email from your compliance contact.

securitybot: Ticket created: SUP-2026-488 — privacy escalation (automated).

alex_security: Quick clarifications for the audit: Redwood acts as processor; customers are controllers. Sub-processors: our list is in Console → Settings → Subprocessors (also available via /v1/subprocessors). If your tenant uses our managed KMS/HSM: we can provide a vendor-signed key-provenance statement and HSM attestation logs (timeline: ~48–72h for vendor-sourced attestation). If you brought your own key (BYOK), supply the key-id and we can show rotations/usage logs. Audit logs (who requested deletion, when) are under Console → Compliance → Audit Logs and we can export as NDJSON or CSV.

mike_customer: account/org id: org_9f7e
Here's the exact error body we got when we tried the delete call earlier:

{
  "error": "forbidden",
  "message": "token principal does not match owner; missing claim 'org'",
  "code": 403,
  "request_id": "req_20260318_01"
}

julia_support: That explains it — token principal mismatch. Two common causes: (1) using a workspace token instead of an org-scoped service key, (2) token missing `org` claim after rotation. Repro steps for us internally: 

1) Run delete with a service key that includes the `org` claim: `AUTH_TOKEN=$(cat /etc/secrets/service_org_key)`
2) curl -X DELETE https://api.redwood.ai/v1/records -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUTH_TOKEN" -d '{"owner":"eu-42","record_ids":["abc123"]}' -H 'X-Request-ID: repro-<ts>'
3) Check API gateway logs for `request_id` and then correlate to ELK: `kubectl logs -l app=api-gateway | grep repro-<ts>`

If you want, we can run the deletion for you once we verify ownership from your compliance contact. We'll also generate a deletion certificate showing record ids and timestamp.

ops_oncall: For internal run (if privacy approves): 
- Use `service-delete` tool: `./bin/service-delete --org org_9f7e --ids abc123 --auth-file /opt/keys/org_9f7e.key`
- Add `--dry-run` first to confirm affected rows.
- After running, check `audit.events` index in ES: `GET /audit.events/_search?q=owner:eu-42 AND event_type:delete` (time range: last 7d).

mike_customer: OK to escalate. Compliance contact is privacy@clientcorp.com (legal entity: ClientCorp Ltd, EU jurisdiction). Please include CSV export with columns: `record_id`, `created_at`, `model`, `prompt_hash`, `deleted_at`. And provide deletion confirmation timestamp and the HSM attestation/statement for the keys.

alex_security: Noted. We'll prepare: (A) CSV export of matched records, (B) deletion certificate with ISO 27001-friendly format, (C) KMS/HSM provenance: if managed by Redwood we'll request vendor attestation; if BYOK we will provide usage logs. Expect initial packet in ~24h, HSM vendor attestation up to 72h.

julia_support: I've updated ticket SUP-2026-488 and set priority=P1. Asking Privacy team to assemble the DPA evidence pack. Mike — please confirm you want us to perform the delete or if you prefer self-serve instructions only. Once confirmed we'll proceed and attach CSV + deletion cert to the ticket.

mike_customer: Confirm delete by Redwood. Please proceed. Thanks.

julia_support: Copy — proceeding. Will post updates here when the export and deletion cert are ready (target ETA 24–48h).
